# appdynamics_role_user_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an AppDynamics RBAC role directly to a user. Reflected on the user's implicit roles list (verified live).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appdynamics_role_user_assignment" "jdoe_read_only" {
  role_id = appdynamics_role.read_only.id
  user_id = appdynamics_user.jdoe.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number)
- `user_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<role_id>/<user_id>"
terraform import appdynamics_role_user_assignment.jdoe_read_only 2695/3567
```
